info.name: GitHub — Gruvbox Dark Soft
info.description: A comprehensive, uncompromising Gruvbox Dark Soft theme for the entire GitHub UI. Every element — navigation, headers, buttons, code blocks, diff views, modals, forms, sidebar, markdown rendering, labels, alerts, and more — is fully re-skinned using the authentic Gruvbox Dark Soft palette. Warm, retro-groove aesthetics meet GitHub's complex interface for a cohesive, eye-friendly coding experience. Applies to all GitHub pages: repositories, pull requests, issues, actions, settings, explore, and beyond.
info.additionalInfo:
v1.0.0 — Initial release.

Features:
• Full Gruvbox Dark Soft palette applied across all GitHub UI elements
• Contrast mode selector: Dark Soft (default), Dark Medium, Dark Hard
• UI Font Size selector: Standard 14px, Small 12px, Large 16px, Extra Large 18px
• UI Density selector: Comfortable (default), Compact, Spacious
• Custom Accent Color override
• Custom Font Family override (default: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code)
• Covers: navigation, headers, buttons, code blocks, diffs, modals, forms, sidebar, labels, alerts, markdown, and more
